title: Hecke algebras, Specht modules and Gröbner–Shirshov bases
note: Read 2026-11-23 (author's copy, uploaded by the owner). §4, Prop. 4.3 (pp. 275–276): a Gröbner–Shirshov basis of the Iwahori–Hecke algebra H_n(q) of type A_{n-1}, for both deg-lex and deg-rlex orders: the quadratic relation, far commutation, and the family T_{i+1,j}T_{i+1} − T_i T_{i+1,j} (i ≥ j). This is the q-deformation of the [bokut2001] completion family; standard monomials T_{1,j_1}⋯T_{n-1,j_{n-1}}, n! of them. Their relation is T² = (q−1)T + q; the folio's convention D σ² = (Q−Q⁻¹)σ + 1 matches it under q = Q², T = Qσ (check: T² = Q²σ² = (Q²−1)T + Q²).
